time_convention: tau is linear CFM time; paper cosine-VP display time t=(2/pi)*atan(tau/(1-tau)); never substitute display t for tau in readout
sampler: Heun, shared uniform tau grid with exact inserted stopping times
source_seeds: 0..255, separate CPU generators; shared exactly across all methods and groups
reuse_scope: U-Net S1 N98023 only; use EMA; no warm-start of smaller N or other group
mlp: 6400-wide time-FiLM LayerNorm SiLU MLP, learned time-dependent scalar velocity skip initialized to -x; no hard low-dimensional bottleneck; parameter count not matched to U-Net
publication_gate: fixed 200k training is a budget, not a convergence proof; assess per-time clean-readout fidelity, velocity error, activation health, fixed-source diversity and sampler refinement; checkpoint reaching budget is trained_pending_review
compatibility_note: New runs match legacy objective/hyperparameters; exact historical GPU random stream/optimizer trajectory not claimed. One paired training seed is not architecture-level causal evidence.
